name: phd-nd-course-before-entry-no-prior-program
description: Red-team F7 (2026-09-12): a Notre Dame course dated before the entry term, for a student whose standing says “No prior graduate degree” and whose record has no Notre Dame master's. Until today it was routed through §5.2 as unfinished-master's transfer credit — a row against a program the student said they never had, reachable by accident because the entry term starts out as the coming fall. Now no transfer row opens: the line says the course is dated before the entry term with no prior program on record, and what to check. §4.4.1 still sees the course.

detailIncludes: CSE 60641 (Notre Dame, before entering the program)

CSE 60641: not counted — dated before your entry term (Fall 2026), but your record shows no prior graduate program
check the entry term under Your standing
